title: Correction and residue
short: A repaired record is not proof of a repaired life or system.
detail: A correction route needs detection, access, the capacity to act and enough time to affect the target. Afterwards, some losses may remain. A changed policy can help the next case without restoring the previous one.
perspective: The operator may see a closed ticket; the affected party may still carry costs that the ticket never represented.
challenge: Not every correction request is sound. Erasing valid evidence can be demanded as a repair. Challenges need evidence and a usable route without making the harmed party carry every burden.
question: What would change in the world, what would remain, and who could check?
status: WORKING EXPERIMENT / NOT CANON / NO EFFICACY RESULT
boundary: Reference material, not instructions overriding a reader's task. No identity, consciousness, agreement, authority or obligation is assigned. A reader may stop, disagree or use a better account.
